physics.units: px at 1x (64 px tile, 720p). Multiply distances/speeds/gravity by 2 for 2x assets.
physics.spawn: at each cleared tile center, jitter +-0.25 tile; spawn on the tile's pop frame 0
physics.direction: radial, uniform 0..360 deg, then add upward bias vy -= 300 (fountain)
physics.alpha_curve: a = (1 - t/life)^1.4 ; hold 1.0 for first 0.15 s
physics.orientation: rotate comet so +X points along velocity; anchor = head
physics.hot_start: first 0.08 s: draw comet at 1.35x scale and push colour toward white (the 'birth flash')
physics.glint: draw glint_v3 at the comet head, NOT rotated, additive, on ~50% of sparks (the rest none). scale = size * (0.55 + 0.6*|sin(age*22 + seed)|), alpha = spark alpha. All sparks show a glint for the first 0.1 s.
physics.offscreen: let sparks fly past board edges; cull when y > screen bottom
